Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

governance (development version)

Documentation

  • get_scores() and the vignettes now report how reliable the specific-factor scores are and advise against using gov_s_policy. That factor has almost no variance of its own (omega-hierarchical < .01), because the written-policy items are the core of the general score. gov_s_finance is the one subscore recommended alongside gov_score. No scores change.

governance 0.1.0

Breaking changes

  • get_scores() now applies the 2023 governance index model by default. It is a bifactor item response model fit to all 501(c)(3) full Form 990 filers for tax year 2023, and returns:
    • gov_score, with its standard error gov_score_se;
    • four specific-factor scores (gov_s_finance, gov_s_minutes, gov_s_policy, gov_s_comp);
    • gov_count (number of the 16 practices reported) and gov_n_items.
    Item parameters are fixed at 2023 values (gov_model_2023), so scores from other years share the 2023 scale. The previous six-factor model and its total.score are still available with get_scores(x, model = "legacy-2018").
  • mirt is now a dependency.

New features

  • get_features() also returns the 16 GI_* practice items used by the 2023 model. They add the audit committee (Part XII line 2c), compilation or review, committee minutes, and the pay process for other officers, and keep the conflict-of-interest disclosure and monitoring items separate.
  • get_features() also returns five RISK_* indicators: insider transactions, loans to insiders, family or business ties, management company, and asset diversion.
  • Missing fields used only by the 2023 items produce a message, not an error.
  • get_governance_data() retrieves the additional fields, and dat_example includes them.
  • data-raw/fit-model-2023.R reproduces the shipped model from the efile archive.

Documentation

  • New article, “Governance Across the Sector” (vignette("overview")): practice prevalence and governance scores for every 501(c)(3) full-990 filer, broken out by size, subsector, state and organization age, with risk disclosures and change from 2021 to 2024. Its summary tables are built by data-raw/make-overview-data.R.
  • “Making Governance Scores” now documents the 2023 index: population and data preparation, item selection and coding, dimensionality, the model comparison, scoring and validation (invariance and predictive validity).
  • The derivation of the 2018 model and its known issues moved to a new article, “The Legacy 2018 Model”, with its tables rebuilt and several descriptions corrected.
  • “Getting Started” and “Governance Workflow” describe the 16 GI_* items, the RISK_* indicators and every column get_scores() adds. “Getting 990 Data” lists every field the 2023 items read.

Fixes

  • get_features(): audited financial statements (P4_LINE_12) now count consolidated audits (Part IV line 12b, F9_04_AFS_CONSOL_X) as well as separate audits (line 12a), matching how the factor model was trained. Previously organizations audited only on a consolidated basis scored 0. F9_04_AFS_CONSOL_X is optional: without it, a message is shown and line 12a alone is used. get_governance_data() now retrieves the field, and dat_example includes it.
  • Documented four known issues with the shipped factor model in the “Making Governance Scores” vignette and in ?get_scores:
    • the training sample excluded fully independent boards;
    • a coding bug zeroed out the audit-committee item (Part XII line 2c);
    • total.score puts negative implied weights on several good-practice features;
    • six factors over-fit 12 binary items. These motivated the 2023 refit.
  • Retrieval tests now read the local fixture tables as CSV, since panel990 defaults to parquet sources.

governance 0.0.1.0000

  • Added get_governance_data() and get_governance_scores() to import IRS 990 efile tables through the companion panel990 package and assemble the input to get_features() (Parts IV, VI, XII and Schedule M), merged to one row per filing. Retrieval uses panel990::panelize() with a sample frame that restricts the data to full 990 filers (RETURN_TYPE == "990") via the SFW form_type filter.

  • Fixed a Part XII normalization bug where the accounting-method “other” case was detected with is.na() on a free-text field that reads as "" (not NA) from data.table::fread, causing every filer to be labeled “other” and P12_LINE_1 to collapse to 0. Accrual is now detected correctly.

  • get_features() normalization is now robust to how blank cells are encoded: NA and "" yield identical features (blank yes/no responses score 0).

  • get_features() now normalizes the returned ORG_EIN to a 9-digit string (previously dead code) and accepts integer and "EIN-.." forms.

  • Member counts are coerced to numeric, so character input from fread no longer errors on the independent-member ratio.

  • Fixed a copy-paste bug in the missing-column checks so the error names the actual missing columns.

  • get_scores() now stops with a clear message if a feature column is entirely NA, rather than returning invalid scores. psych moved to Imports.

  • Rebuilt the bundled dat_example from the NCCS efile v2.1 archive (tax year 2022, 5,000 organizations) so the example reflects current field formats.

  • Added a testthat test suite covering normalization, scoring, and the fixes above.

  • Refreshed the vignettes, README, and pkgdown reference index.

  • Initial CRAN submission.
